### Fixed

- `eat` and `unpack` appended a whole new block for the keys they added, so a
  project file grew a second `@test` header every time one of them ran, and a
  third the time after that. `remember` has always inserted into the block that
  lists the profile, and the two ways of editing one file disagreed. All three
  now put a key in the same place.

  A header is matched only when it lists exactly the same profiles: a `@test`
  key still starts its own block rather than joining `@test,production`, since
  joining would hand the key to production too.

### Documentation

- Windows is not supported, and the docs now say so rather than leaving it to
  be discovered.
